mapper.insert: insert into `groupon` (dish_id, leader_user_id, groupon_price, required_size, current_size, status, expire_time, pickup_point_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{dishId}, #{leaderUserId}, #{grouponPrice}, #{requiredSize}, #{currentSize}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{pickupPointId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update `groupon` set current_size = current_size + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{grouponId} and status = 1 and current_size < required_size and expire_time > #{now}
mapper.select:
select g.id, g.dish_id as dishId, g.groupon_price as grouponPrice, g.required_size as requiredSize, g.current_size as currentSize, g.status, g.expire_time as expireTime, g.complete_time as completeTime, g.create_time as createTime, d.name as dishName, d.image as dishImage, d.price as originalPrice, d.unit, d.origin, p.name as pickupPointName, u.name as leaderName from `groupon` g left join dish d on d.id = g.dish_id left join pickup_point p on p.id = g.pickup_point_id left join user u on u.id = g.leader_user_id
and g.status = #{status}
and d.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by g.create_time desc
